content.text: Worth it to give that some run?
Screw it, man. It’s all part of the same thing.
I just don’t want to be nit-picking every little thing but I think I’ve already jumped the shark on that

I think it’s worth trying to interview the people fired and see what they give you, if anything. They have nothing to lose unless they got a severance. I can see Colangelo gives you nothing so your only hope on any of these stories is someone who was let go. If you get real lucky, maybe somebody challenges something in court, some day
Yeah. Do you know who else besides Reginald?

In other Tigers ticket sales news, three representatives were fired on Monday for drinking beer in the parking lot with co-workers after a recent mask-making shift — further fueling employees’ belief that Ilitch Holdings is trying to get ahold of as many employees as easily as possible to save money.
Not get ahold... get rid

As of the new year, at least 77 business-side employees had left the Tigers between 2018-19, including 42 last year as new upper management began decimating the organization’s culture established by late team owner Mike Ilitch, according to records kept by the Free Press.
Those two will strike a nerve

I’ll try to find out the other 2. It’s a compelling story, I feel. I guess Reginald was fired by Spencer Ambrosious, who is the VP of ticket sales for Wings. How does the VP of ticket sales for wings fire someone for drinking outside a factory?
Yep, lemme know
They may strike a nerve but they aren’t unfair and definitely not untrue.
I know. And it’s shaking more people out of there to talk to me, hopefully
Phones are blowing up across Detroit right now. I’m already feeling it
Don’t encourage me, Dan
Lol
It was a topic that I didn’t start on our morning USPBL call
Josh Bogia and Jake Kroening - the other 2 names
Btw- how do you get fired while “volunteering”?
Mike MacAdams left right
Yes- with Nationals Florida facility now
He’s frustrating
Like he won’t answer you?

Yeah. To be fair, I started reaching out to him over the winter, when he was still employed there. But I realized he was gone when I texted him about the masks thing, and I know they didn’t treat him well
Is his wife’s name Laura? Only reason I ask is because a Laura MacAdams followed me on Twitter today
So that made me think about reaching back out to him
Yes Laura

Ok. I’ve been very passive with him but I want to be like, “Dude, you don’t work there anymore. You know what’s going on. You know how you feel about it. I’m giving you complete anonymity and don’t even need quotes, just things confirmed, what gives?”
I’ve texted him probably 5 times. I don’t have any cards left to play. What’s he like?
Good guy. Lived on my street in GP. He is fairly passive and avoids controversy. Probably just doesn’t want to be involved but maybe just reiterate that he doesn’t need to be on the record.
K
Damn I just sent him four long texts
Call me later on
